relationships.subject: Mitochondrial ROS
relationships.evidence_quote: Mitochondrial ROS and mitochondrial DNA can act as damage-associated molecular patterns that activate the NLR family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome (40, 41).

relationships.subject: PACAP
relationships.evidence_quote: By preserving mitochondrial integrity, reducing ROS generation, and promoting clearance of damaged mitochondria, PACAP can indirectly suppress NLRP3 inflammasome activation (3).

key_findings: PACAP preserves mitochondrial homeostasis across nerve injury, cerebral ischemia and retinal neuropathy.
PACAP may indirectly suppress NLRP3 inflammasome activation via reduced mitochondrial ROS.
